reportsPacks.title: Report packs
reportsPacks.sub: Ready reports for a bank, a loan file, your partner or your own records: a PDF on your letterhead and a spreadsheet file. They read the same numbers as the library and Finance.

monthly.name: Monthly business
monthly.d: Last month: sales, profit, orders, average order, discounts and fixed costs.

bank.name: Bank
bank.d: Last month's sales, profit and fixed costs, and the balance of every account. For a bank or loan file.

stock.name: Stock
stock.d: Styles to restock now and styles sitting unsold.

sales.name: Sales
sales.d: The last 30 days: sales, profit, orders, discounts and orders by weekday.

reportsPacks.letterhead: The PDF has your shop's name, address and phone at the top. Change them in Settings. The PDF is in English.

schedule.title: Send it by itself
schedule.sub: Off until you switch it on. A short summary goes to your own Telegram. Nothing goes to a buyer or a supplier. The PDF stays here to download.
